findings.title: benten-drop envelope_sig module pub fns lack direct standalone tests
findings.details: `benten_drop::envelope_sig::{sign_envelope, verify_envelope, build_envelope_message}` and `EnvelopeSigError::{SignatureMalformed, VerifyFailed, VerifyingKeyMalformed}` (per docs/public-api/benten-drop.txt) are exercised INDIRECTLY through `DropBundle::verify_envelope_signature` / `consume_offline` / `tamper_envelope_signature_for_test` in tf3f_envelope_plus_per_node_sig_defense_in_depth.rs. No direct standalone test in crates/benten-drop/tests/ constructs the lower-level helpers with synthesised vk/sig/msg byte triples to exercise each `EnvelopeSigError` variant. The indirect coverage is genuine (the tamper-detect path traverses verify_envelope and produces EnvelopeSignatureInvalid by routing through the From-impl); a future refactor that splits the module out or changes signatures would still be caught by the bundle-level tests, but variant-specific message coverage is implicit not pinned. Per HARD RULE clause-(a) this is OUT OF SCOPE for R4b convergence (the surface is genuinely covered end-to-end; the gap is a granularity preference, not a missing pin); flag MINOR for the next R6 R1 pim-N meta-sweep to consider whether per-variant EnvelopeSigError direct pins should land alongside the bundle-level tampers.
findings.disposition: DISAGREE-WITH-EXPLANATION — coverage is genuine via end-to-end tamper paths through DropBundle::verify_envelope_signature, EnvelopeSigError variant construction sites in src/envelope_sig.rs all reachable from DropBundle methods, and the From<EnvelopeSigError> for DropBundleError impl which the bundle tests do exercise (PerNodeSignatureInvalid + EnvelopeSignatureInvalid both fire). Adding standalone per-variant tests would be inline-tests cost without changing the failure-detection footprint.

findings.title: DropBundleError::AuthorizationGrantFailed + CodecError lack negative-path test pins
findings.details: Of the 7 DropBundleError variants in docs/public-api/benten-drop.txt, 5 are exercised in tests (EnvelopeSignatureInvalid + PerNodeAeadAuthenticationFailed + PerNodeSignatureInvalid + UnsupportedDropMode + UnsupportedDropVersion — all via tf3f_* tests). The 2 unexercised variants are `AuthorizationGrantFailed` (constructed at src/bundle.rs:453 in the per-node consume path when AuthorizationGrant verification fails) and `CodecError` (constructed at 4 sites: encode_encrypted_node, decode_encrypted_node, to_cbor_bytes, parse_cbor_bytes). The construction sites are reachable from public methods but no test arranges the failure (e.g., feeding mal-CBOR bytes to `parse_cbor_bytes`, or constructing a DropBundle whose embedded grant has an invalid binding_sig).
findings.disposition: BELONGS-NAMED-NOW — add to .addl/phase-4-meta/r4b-fp-l2.md as 2-line presence-pin candidates for inline closure at R4b-FP (matches the inline-1-LOC pattern of Phase-4-Foundation R4b-FP-3 r4b-l2-1/2). If R4b-FP cluster doesn't materialize this round, file as named follow-up rows in docs/future/phase-4-meta-backlog.md under a §new-surface-pins heading. Per HARD RULE clause-(b) the destination IS named NOW: this JSON report names the file path + entry shape.

findings.title: benten-crypto-suite primitives module is re-export-only; lint exposure not pinned by negative test
findings.details: `benten_crypto_suite::primitives` re-exports blake3 / ed25519_dalek / ml_dsa / sha2 / sha3 (per docs/public-api/benten-crypto-suite.txt:'pub use ...primitives::*'). This is a deliberate boundary: the integration crate owns its own re-export of the vetted upstream primitives, and the `boundary::CryptoPrimitiveCallSiteAudit::direct_primitive_use_outside_suite` scanner enforces that NO OTHER crate calls these directly. The scanner machinery exists (boundary.rs) but no integration test in crates/benten-crypto-suite/tests/ invokes `CryptoPrimitiveCallSiteAudit::scan_workspace()` and asserts the returned `direct_primitive_use_outside_suite()` vec is empty. The CI workflow may run the scanner separately, but a Rust integration test pin would close the regression-guard at the same surface as the rest of the suite.
findings.disposition: BELONGS-NAMED-NOW — file as a candidate row in .addl/phase-4-meta-core/r4b-followups.md (or wherever the campaign carries forward R4b dispositions). One-test, ~20-LOC, calls `CryptoPrimitiveCallSiteAudit::scan_workspace()` and `assert_eq!(audit.direct_primitive_use_outside_suite(), vec![])`. Per HARD RULE clause-(b) destination is named NOW.

findings.title: public-api.txt baselines transition is the dominant new-surface signal at HEAD
findings.details: All 14 docs/public-api/*.txt files were ~10-line stubs at phase-4-foundation-close and are now full-content baselines (~20.5K total LOC across the workspace).
